properties.name: IDExternal
properties.comment: Public identifier of endpoint. May be advertised on the network.

properties.name: Direction
properties.comment: Input or output (input -> samples flow into endpoint from network, output->samples flow out of endpoint into network).

properties.name: NetworkAssignmentIDs
properties.comment: ID(s) of the Network Assignment(s) this endpoint is using.

properties.name: StreamModeCapabilityIDs
properties.comment: Media stream mode capabilities of this endpoint. List of indexes into OcaMediaTransportApplication.MediaStreamModeCapabilities.

properties.name: ClockONo
properties.comment: ONo of OcaMediaClock3 media clock for this endpoint.

properties.name: ChannelMapDynamic
properties.comment: TRUE if and only if channel map may be modified at runtime.

properties.name: ChannelMap
properties.comment: Map of this endpoint’s signal channels to OCA Ports of the owning OcaMediaTransportApplication object. Each input endpoint channel may be mapped to zero or more output Ports; each output endpoint channel may be mapped to at most one input Port.

properties.name: AlignmentLevel
properties.comment: Alignment Level of the endpoint. The dBFS value is referenced to the endpoint’s fullscale value, not to Device’s internal fullscale value.

properties.name: CurrentStreamMode
properties.comment: Stream mode of current connection. If there is a no current connection, value is undefined.

properties.name: SecurityType
properties.comment: Security type of this endpoint, if any.

properties.name: AdaptationData
properties.comment: Adaptation-specific connection data, e.g. IP addresses and ports of input and output endpoints. Specific media transport adaptations will define the fine-structure of this OcaBlob.

properties.name: RedundantSetID
properties.comment: ID of redundant set this endpoint belongs to. Unique within OcaMediaTransportApplication instance.
